title: Frontend: Image Gallery
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Image Gallery. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App({items=[Alpha,Beta,Gamma]}), a gallery carousel using title strings and local one-pixel images with alt=title. slides container [data-testid=slides] contains one articles with h2 titles. Next/Previous use data-action=next/previous. Navigation clamps at valid start indices. Empty items renders No images. Each thumbnail[data-thumbnail=index] opens native dialog labelled Image viewer; [data-testid=viewer] shows selected title and Close viewer closes it. This exercise focuses selection/window semantics rather than remote image loading.
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Keep selected image ID separate from the underlying list.
alternativeApproaches: Add a predictable focus policy for keyboard navigation between thumbnails and the lightbox.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Empty gallery; broken source; opening/closing.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
